summary: Comprehensive testing of ROSCA Geoblocking feature completed. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all geoblocking components working correctly including settings toggle, IP whitelist add/remove, and restricted access page.

issues: When geoblocking is disabled, the page shows 'Unknown IP' and no block message - this is expected behavior but could be improved to show actual IP even when not blocked

GET /api/admin/ip-logs - returns visitor IP logs (superadmin only)
GET /api/admin/ip-logs with filters - country_filter and blocked_only work

RBAC: Moderator denied access to IP logs (403)
Integration: Full whitelist flow (add -> verify -> remove -> verify)
Integration: Geoblocking toggle flow (enable -> verify -> disable)
Admin Dashboard Geoblocking tab displays correctly
IP Whitelist add/remove works in UI
/restricted page shows blocked message and UI elements
critical_code_review_comments: IP geolocation uses ip-api.com free service - local/private IPs return US by default (expected behavior)
Geoblocking middleware is implemented but disabled by default - this is correct for safety
RestrictedAccess page could be enhanced to show actual IP even when geoblocking is disabled

context_for_next_testing_agent: Geoblocking feature fully tested and working. All admin endpoints require superadmin role. Geoblocking is disabled by default. When enabled, only visitors from allowed countries (default: US) can access the site. Local/private IPs are treated as US by default. IP whitelist allows specific IPs to bypass restrictions. The /restricted page is shown to blocked users.
